label: Diagram 5.4
caption: Diagram 5.4 | Permanent screen protection | Protection from collision with open windows etc. | K5 | .1
description: This is Diagram 5.4, titled 'Permanent screen protection', showing two drawings side by side. On the left is an elevation of an openable window positioned above a vertical‑slat screen. A level symbol (an inverted triangle above a triangle) marks the floor at lower left. A vertical dimension line to the right of the screen reads '800mm from floor level', measuring up to the top of the screen. Two horizontal dimension lines at the base, one on the left and one in the center, read 'Less than 75mm'. The text 'See para 5.8' appears at the top left. On the right is a vertical section labelled 'Section detail of screen', showing the screen as a U‑shaped profile with black blocks on the vertical arms, connected by a horizontal foot at the bottom, with the word 'glass' in the space between the arms. Three dashed circles, each containing a diagonal double‑headed arrow, mark the gaps at the top left, middle right, and bottom right; each is labelled '<75mm'.
